note: One example is one training clip: the video from 0 s up to the trigger time t, with a question asked at the start. The label says whether the assistant should answer at t ('<Yes> …', the asked-about content has just appeared) or stay silent ('<No>', the content never appears). The question is shown at t=0 in the timeline because the model is asked it while the clip plays; the data gives no separate ask time.
